title: Grateful Dead Live at Veterans' Memorial Coliseum on 1982-09-23

ai_review.summary: A lively early‑80’s New Haven show captured on a solid audience tape, highlighted by a smoking Baby Blue encore, The Wheel jam and soaring Althea.
ai_review.review: The performance is high‑energy with standout moments like the blazing Baby Blue, an extended Wheel/Other One drum‑break, and tight Sailor > Saint transitions.  While the first set opens a bit loose (notably a sloppy Alabama), the audience recording remains consistently clear enough to convey the excitement of the night.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars, praising both the musical fire and a generally good‑quality audience tape; occasional comments about a sloppy start are outweighed by strong positive sentiment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistently clear for an audience source; no major dropouts, though early set is a bit muddy compared to later sections.

standout_songs: The Wheel > Other One drum jam
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set starts a little loose but gains momentum; second set builds into a powerful drum‑break and finishes with an emotional Baby Blue encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Kicks off with high‑voltage Alabama, delivers strong solos (especially on Sailor) and locks into the post‑drum rhythmic jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals and slide guitar on Rooster praised; vocal work on Althea noted as excellent.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s keyboard/vocal contributions highlighted during Johnny B. Goode; overall solid keyboard texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Post‑drum segment described as "smoking" with the drummers driving a tight, extended jam that lifts the second set.
